facts.fact: Pula Investments, the family office of UK financier Stephen Lansdown, anchors Botswana Tech Fund, which TechCabal says has GBP 10 million (USD 13.5 million) in committed capital with a first close of GBP 5 million (USD 6.7 million); the fund is run from Botswana with Launch Africa; no signing date is given, so the 2026-04-27 publication date is used.
